content:
A Secret Letter for My Ragsss… 

En Ragsss,

Indha letter unakku mattum dhaan. Namma friendship pathi ellaarukkum solla mudiyadha sila feelings irukku… adha indha secret letter-la un kitta share pannanum-nu thonuchu.

Ragsss, nee en life-la vandhadhukku apram, friendship-na enna-ngiradhula sila vishayangalai naan innum nallaa purinjukitten. Oru person namma life-la vandhu, avanga presence mattum vechi namakku happiness kudukka mudiyum-ngiradhai feel pannirukken.

May 7, 2026, morning 7:30 AM namma pesa start pannom. Andha chinna beginning en life-la ivlo meaningful-aana friendship-ah maarum-nu appo naan nenachirukka maatten. Konjam konjam-ah nee enakku close aana. Un kooda pesura moments, nee kaattura care, namma share pannina chinna chinna memories ellame enakku precious aayiduchu.

Un kooda pesura chinna moments kooda enakku meaningful-ah irukkum. Nee happy-ah irundhaa enakkum santhosham. Nee sad-ah irundhaa, un feelings enna-nu purinjukka thonum. Unakku nalladhu nadakkanum, nee healthy-ah irukkanum, un smile eppovume irukkanum-ngiradhu en manasula irukkura genuine wish.

Sila neram en feelings-ai words-la solla theriyama pogalaam. Sila neram naan overthink pannalaam. Aana onnu mattum unakku theriyanum — un friendship-ai naan romba value panren. Un feelings-ai respect pannanum, unakku nalla friend-ah irukkanum-nu sincere-ah ninaikkiren.

Ragsss, un kooda share pannina sila memories enakku romba special. Nee enakku KitKat vaangi kuduthadhu, Murugan kitta unakkaga vendinadhu, nee kudutha Murugan statue, SIH work days, namma pesina moments, chinna chinna surprises — idhellame en manasula oru special place vechirukku.

Namma friendship eppovume happy moments mattum dhaan irukkanum-nu illa. Sila misunderstandings, busy days, distance, changes ellame life-la varalaam. Aana edhu nadandhaalum, namma bond-la care-um respect-um understanding-um irukkanum-nu aasapaduren.

Unakku oru naal indha letter padikkumbodhu, “Gokul en friendship-ai genuinely care pannirukaan” nu feel aana, adhuve enakku romba meaningful.

Ragsss, nee un life-la neraya achieve pannanum. Un dreams ellame nijamaaganum. Nee eppovume un worth-ai marandhuda koodadhu. Unakku happiness mattum illa, peace-um kidaikkanum. Nee kashtapadra nerathula unakku support irukkanum; nee happy-ah irukkumbodhu un happiness-ai share panna people irukkanum.

Naanum unakku oru nalla friend-ah irukkanum-nu aasapaduren. Nee happy-ah irukkumbodhu un happiness-la share pannanum; nee kashtathula irukkumbodhu un feelings-ai purinjukka try pannanum. Unakku support venum-na, ennaala mudinja alavukku un pakkathula irukkanum. Naan perfect illa; sila neram en words or actions correct-ah illaama pogalaam. Aana un friendship-ai care-oda, respect-oda preserve pannanum-ngira intention enakku genuine.

En parents en life-la romba important. Avanga mela enakku irukkura love-um respect-um eppovume special. Adhe nerathula, un friendship-kum en life-la oru unique place irukku. Ovvoru relationship-um different; un place unakku mattum dhaan.

Indha letter unakku oru small reminder-ah irukkattum — nee care pannappadura person, nee value pannappadura friend, and un smile romba beautiful.

Namma friendship-la innum neraya memories create pannanum. Future-la indha days-ai thirumba nyabagam panni smile panna mudiyanum. Life busy aanaalum, namma friendship-la irukkura care and respect eppovume irukkanum.

Ragsss, nee un life-la nalla things neraya achieve pannanum. Nee happy-ah irukkanum. Un manasula irukkura worries ellam konjam konjam-ah kuraiyanum. Unakku peace, confidence, and genuine happiness kidaikkanum.

Indha letter-la naan solla virumbura most important thing:

Nee en life-la irukkura special friend. Un friendship enakku precious. Un happiness enakku important. 

Thank you, Ragsss, en life-la oru special-aana friendship-oda part-ah irundhadhukku. Nee enakku kudutha care, happiness, and memories ellathukkum romba thankful.

Indha letter-la naan ezhuthunadhu en feelings-oda oru part dhaan. Ellathaiyum words-la explain panna mudiyadhu. Aana indha pages-ai padikkumbodhu, unakku oru vishayam puriyanum:

Nee en life-la vandhadhukku naan genuinely thankful. Namma friendship enakku precious.

Always be happy, Ragsss. Un heart eppovume light-ah, peaceful-ah irukkattum. Un smile eppovume irukkanum.

With all my care, love and friendship,

Un Gokullll… always. !!
title: Personal Letter
